status: Migration rules from the read-only title scan. Shared-noun and review cases are not automatically converted.
scope: Definition title paragraph only. Preserve all following body paragraphs, including bold formatting.
general_rules: Extract rich-text names from the first title paragraph only; remove title-level bold wrappers, not body formatting.
Split ordinary name lists at text commas outside parentheses and math nodes, whether the comma is bold or plain.
Keep mathematical trees intact. A comma within math, such as d(x,y), is not a name separator.
Keep notation attached to its name. There are 59 mixed titles consisting of bold text plus plain whitespace and math, and 162 titles containing math overall.
Do not split names merely because the title contains 'and' or 'or'.
Recognize both strong and with(font-series,bold,...). Fourteen title wrappers contain a one-paragraph document; treat this as the same title, not extra body text.
Preserve the two existing hlinks in title text as rich text; do not discard their targets.
Only the explicitly listed parentheses below are attribution or alias fields. Other parentheses remain part of the name.
Cases needing interpretation are listed separately; no body-based inference is authorized.
